translations.zh: 仁宗即位，改東上閤門使，真授隴州團練使、知雄州。
translations.literal: When Renzong ascended the throne, Jixun was made Eastern Upper Gate Commissioner and formally appointed military commissioner of Longzhou and administrator of Xiongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Renzong ascended the throne, Jixun was made Eastern Upper Gate Commissioner and formally appointed military commissioner of Longzhou and administrator of Xiongzhou.

translations.zh: 其冬，契丹獵燕薊，候卒報有兵入鈔，邊州皆警。
translations.literal: That winter the Khitan hunted in Yan and Ji; frontier scouts reported troops entering to raid, and the border prefectures were all alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the Khitan hunted in Yan and Ji. Frontier scouts reported troops entering to raid, and the border prefectures were all put on alert.

translations.zh: 繼勳曰：「契丹歲賴漢金繒，何敢損盟好邪？」
translations.literal: Jixun said: "The Khitan rely on Han gold and silks every year—how would they dare harm the treaty alliance?"
translations.idiomatic: Jixun said: "The Khitan rely on Han gold and silks every year—how would they dare harm the treaty alliance?"

translations.zh: 居自若，已，乃知渤海人叛契丹，行剽兩界也。
translations.literal: He remained as calm as before; only later did they learn that Bohai people had rebelled against the Khitan and were raiding both sides of the border.
translations.idiomatic: He remained perfectly calm. Only later did they learn that Bohai rebels were raiding both sides of the border.

translations.zh: 擢捧日天武四廂都指揮使、連州防禦使，又知瀛州。
translations.literal: He was promoted to commander of the four wings of the Sun-Upholding Heavenly Martial Guard and defense commissioner of Lianzhou, and again served as administrator of Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to commander of the four wings of the Sun-Upholding Heavenly Martial Guard and defense commissioner of Lianzhou, and again served as administrator of Yingzhou.

translations.zh: 歷步軍馬軍殿前都虞候、步軍副都指揮使、邕州觀察使、涇原路副都總管兼知渭州。
translations.literal: He successively served as vice commander of the Palace Guard for infantry and cavalry, deputy commander of the infantry, observation commissioner of Yongzhou, and deputy overall director of the Jingyuan Route concurrently administering Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive appointments as vice commander of the Palace Guard for infantry and cavalry, deputy commander of the infantry, observation commissioner of Yongzhou, and deputy overall director of the Jingyuan route concurrently administering Weizhou.

translations.zh: 入宿衛，出為天雄軍都總管，願復護邊，既而留不遣。
translations.literal: He entered palace guard service, then went out as overall director of the Tianxiong Army. He wished to return to frontier defense, but was kept and not sent back.
translations.idiomatic: He entered palace guard service, then was posted as overall director of the Tianxiong Army. He asked to return to frontier defense, but was kept at court and not sent back.

translations.zh: 後為真定府定州路都總管，改威武軍節度觀察留後，遂拜保順軍節度使、馬軍副都指揮使。
translations.literal: Later he served as overall director of the Zhending Prefecture Dingzhou Route, was changed to military governor and observation commissioner of the Weiwu Army as acting administrator, and was then appointed military governor of the Baoshun Army and deputy commander of the cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Later he served as overall director of the Zhending prefecture Dingzhou route, was made acting military governor and observation commissioner of the Weiwu Army, and was then appointed military governor of the Baoshun Army and deputy commander of the cavalry.
